title: Windy Mind refusal and stop codes (contract C5; plan v2.1)
description: The machine signal is the `x-mind-error` RESPONSE HEADER: stable, safe to log and to branch on. Bodies: the /v1/tokens and /internal/v1/agents routes answer {error, code, message}; the compute walls (chat, speech) still answer FastAPI's {detail: <plain words>} until each wall migrates into services/admission.py (S4.0), so clients branch on the header, never on body text. `status` = what Mind answers today; `agent` = what a well-behaved agent does (Windy Agent #445 semantics). Codes marked planned are reserved names, not emitted yet.

grant_off.agent: STOP: no retry, no fallback (also arrives as an SSE {error:{code}} line mid-stream when MIND_STREAM_KILL_ENABLED)

token_read_only.agent: a read token never spends: use another token

owner_only.agent: tokens and agents can't manage tokens (L9)

empty_answer.agent: the model ran out of room before answering: retry once, raise max_tokens, or pick another model

model_not_available.agent: send model "auto" or one from GET /v1/models

early_access.agent: the feature isn't open to this account yet

vision_consent_required.agent: show the picture notice and get the person's OK first

model_cannot_see.agent: send model "auto" or a vision model

dpop_required.agent: send a DPoP proof (EPT+agent on a non-GET)

mode_b_required.agent: the 365-day EPT is retired here: mint an EPT+agent and send a DPoP proof

wrong_audience.agent: mint the EPT+agent with aud windy-mind

not_this_owner.agent: Hub: that agent belongs to another account

ei_too_low.agent: pick another model or auto (not a stop)

ration_spent.agent: not a stop: Retry-After to the 00:00 UTC reset; tell the owner once with x-mind-power-pack-url (D-G: past the free floor without a power pack)

budget_spent.agent: free continues; paid stops until the owner raises the cap

agents_cannot_connect.agent: only the signed-in owner connects a source

humans_only.agent: owner-only route: sign in as the owner

no_identity.agent: sign in with Windy (no identity on this token)

not_your_agent.agent: that agent isn't on this account

chain_not_supported_yet.agent: per-agent order not available yet; the owner's default order applies

invalid_value.agent: fix the field named in the message

oauth_exchange_failed.agent: the provider refused the approval: try again

too_many_rows.agent: ingest: at most 100 rows per request

request_id_conflict.agent: ingest/budget: that request_id belongs to another owner

unauthorized.agent: service callers: a valid X-Service-Token is required

switched_off.agent: the surface is switched off: retry later (Retry-After 60)

bad_input.agent: speech: the voice engine could not read that text

not_authenticated.agent: send a credential: Authorization: Bearer <token> (or DPoP <token> with a DPoP proof)

engine_switched_off.agent: the house switched this engine off; do not call it

unknown_engine.agent: Mind admits no such engine/surface pair (C12)

admit_required.agent: engine: mint an admit from Mind first (C12)

admit_invalid.agent: engine: the admit failed signature/claims; mint a new one

admit_expired.agent: engine: the admit is past exp; mint a new one

admit_exhausted.agent: engine: this admit's max_calls/max_units is used up; mint another (distinct from the engine's own rate limit)

admit_unverifiable.agent: engine: no Mind keys yet; retry shortly

unknown_source.agent: C4 order: use source ids from the registry (provider ids)

embeddings_unavailable.agent: embeddings not configured on Mind; retry later

own_key_required.agent: this model runs only on the owner's own connected key

quota_exhausted.agent: the source's free quota is used up; retry later or use another source

upstream_error.agent: the source didn't answer; retry shortly

stt_translation_unavailable.agent: the GPU speech lane is busy and only it can translate into that language: retry after Retry-After, or ask for English (task translate)

agents_only.agent: this route is for agents; people use /v1/agents/{passport}/power

not_allowed_for_agent.agent: pick one of `allowed` in the body, or ask your owner (not a stop)

switch_rate.agent: too many self-switches this hour: Retry-After

context_too_large.agent: shorten or pick a larger model; not a stop
context_too_large.message: This request is too long for the models available right now. Shorten it, or connect your own key to use a larger model.
context_too_large.note: Mind only: a request that CARRIES TOOLS and does not fit the local GPU lane (MIND_VERON_CTX_TOKENS) skips that lane; when no lane in the chain fits, 413. Plain chat without tools is unchanged (Hub 10-06).

WallBody.description: Compute walls today (chat, speech); branch on the x-mind-error header.
